Title: Check Project Name Input Field Presence
Preconditions: User is in Create Project mode with workspace selected.
Steps: Locate the Project Name input field in the Create Project form.
Expected Result: Project Name input field should be present and enabled for text entry.

Title: Enter Valid Project Name
Preconditions: Project Name input field is visible and enabled.

Expected Result: Project Name input field should accept and display 'NewProject_02112026'.

Preconditions: Project name and workspace are filled in Create Project form.
Steps: After selecting 'Workspace_A' and entering 'NewProject_02112026' as project name, click the Save button.
Expected Result: System should accept the data and process saving the new project.

Title: Verify Success Message After Project Creation
Preconditions: Project creation request was submitted.
Steps: After saving a new project, observe for feedback messages.
Expected Result: A success message should be displayed confirming project creation.

Title: Verify New Project Present in Selected Workspace
